description: READ work without taking it. With `id`, that piece of work: its markdown, read only; work over 20,000 characters comes back as an outline unless you ask for `section` or `full`. With `query`, the work whose words match. With neither, the board: what needs the user, who is on what, and what is ready: hosts that draw MCP Apps show it as one. To DO the work, call take instead: it is the only way anyone learns somebody picked it up.

full.description: with id: the whole text, however long

query.description: words to look for in titles, tags and text

scope.description: with query: "all" (default), "mine", or a team slug

section.description: with id: only the part under this heading; see the outline

name: find_work

markdown.description: with id: its text, or the part asked for

title: Find work
